verdict.rationale: Convex's default CLI workflow (`npx convex dev`) watches your local filesystem but pushes functions to a cloud-hosted 'dev deployment,' not a fully local backend. However, Convex documents a self-hosting option that lets you run the open-source backend on your own servers/Docker, which could satisfy running the whole stack locally, and this works alongside various local infra tools (Postgres, SQLite, etc.). This is a workaround rather than a purpose-built local emulator experience like Firebase's emulator suite. Missing for 10: an explicit, first-party 'local emulator' or fully offline dev-mode equivalent, and independent verification that self-hosted setup replicates the full dev-loop (hot reload, dashboard) locally.
